verdict.rationale: Workable's REST API and MCP server expose a large surface — jobs, candidates, offers, ratings, permission sets, departments, requisitions, webhooks — going well beyond simple CRUD (workable-docs-4/19, workable-docs-5/6/13/16/21/29/32). However, several UI-driven features highlighted in marketing (careers page branding/builder, job board syndication to 200+ boards, custom report builder, AI candidate recommendations) have no documented API endpoints, and there is no discoverable OpenAPI spec to verify full parity (workable-probe-3). Missing for 10: API endpoints/evidence for careers-page customization, job-board posting management, custom report builder, and AI recommendation retrieval via API, plus a formal spec confirming full UI-API parity.
